# Software Configuration Management Plan (SCMP)
<!-- Generated by go-FuSa on 2026-06-19 — DO-178C §11.4 -->

## 1. Purpose

Define the configuration management process for all go-DDS software lifecycle
data. Configuration management is implemented with Git (`github.com/SoundMatt/
go-DDS`) plus GitHub branch protection and release tagging; safety evidence
artifacts are version-controlled alongside the source and regenerated at each
release tag (`.github/workflows/release.yml`).

## 2. Configuration Items

All items listed in the Software Configuration Index (`sci.json`).

## 3. Baseline Management

Each released baseline is an annotated Git tag (`vX.Y.Z`). On tag push,
`release.yml` regenerates and commits the safety evidence set (FMEA, safety
case, SBOM, provenance, SCI, coupling/coverage/cyber reports, gap reports) so
the committed artifacts always reflect the exact state of that baseline. The
version history is recorded in `CLAUDE.md`.

## 4. Change Control

All changes are made on feature branches and merged to the protected `main`
branch via pull request. `main` requires the full CI required-check set to pass
and is squash-merged (`--delete-branch`). CODEOWNERS governs review scope. The
`dco` CI job enforces Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off on every commit.

## 5. Archive and Retrieval

Lifecycle data archived via `gofusa audit-pack`. Checksums recorded in `sci.json`.

## 6. Problem Reporting

Problem reports tracked in `.fusa-problems.json` per DO-178C §11.17.
